programme.title: 星舰战将: 侵略者
programme.desc: 联邦前哨站凯西堡受到异虫攻击。阿莉茜亚号的船员必须疏散生还者和拿走情报。赞坚斯部长的秘密任务出错,引致一场九死一生的救援。

programme.title: 最后的屠龙者
programme.desc: 在一个魔法息微,科技盛行的世界里,15岁的珍妮花史传奇经营著一家魔术师招聘公司,并发现最后一条龙正被猎杀。

programme.title: 穆荷兰大道
programme.desc: 一位充满希望的洛杉矶女演员与一位失忆女子结为好友。当她们共同寻找她身份的过程中,现实与幻觉交织,这是一场如梦似幻,关于野心、身份与好莱坞黑暗面的惊悚之旅。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #20
programme.desc: 以影山的发球为契机,乌野高中逐渐不再让稻荷崎占有优势。 面对势如破竹的乌野,稻荷崎为了重整被扰乱的步调,派出主将北信介。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #21
programme.desc: 一行人与稻荷崎的比赛来到关键的第3局,双方展开激战。宫侑的发球以及角名的迅速攻击使乌野陷入苦战,于是让关键的发球员木下上场。

programme.title: 成为名留青史的坏女人吧 #10
programme.desc: 威尔在罗亚纳村将自己的过去娓娓道来――那是一段围绕著年少悔恨与阴谋的过往。听他话完当年的艾莉西亚回到学校后,校内却又出现举止可疑的学生,她会被新的阴谋所牵连吗?

programme.title: 成为名留青史的坏女人吧 #11
programme.desc: 艾莉西亚对邻国拉瓦尔产生了兴趣。为了成为「名留历史的坏女人」,她考虑要走出游戏剧情外,然而达成的门槛又高又困难。另一方面,丽兹则开始对艾莉西亚与杜克的关系感到不安

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活尸猫之夜 #1
programme.desc: 倒在路边且丧失记忆的爱猫男子九那岐被同样爱猫的阿学与小薰捡回去后,便开始在兄妹俩经营的猫咪咖啡厅「真心猫眼」工作。然而就在某天,猫咪咖啡厅的常客竟突然变成一只可爱猫咪。只要触碰猫就会变成猫的「喵瘟」在世界各地同时爆发,城市陷入一片混乱。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活尸猫之夜 #2
programme.desc: 阿学染上只要触碰猫就会变成猫的NN病毒,他嘱托九那岐留下他,带著妹妹小薰逃跑。陷入「喵瘟」的城市充满了可爱猫咪,九那岐、小薰及田西连为了和阿学分离而难过的时间都没有,只能不断找寻安全的地方。三人好不容易逃进超市,竟在那碰到小薰的同学筒美。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #18
programme.desc: 在春季高中排球第2场比赛中,音驹高中和早流川工业高中双方僵持不下,展开坚决不退让的胜负。早流川的策略为削弱对手的体力以击溃举球员,而音驹的举球员孤爪会如何应对?

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #19
programme.desc: 音驹高中赢得与早流川工业高中的对决,晋升第3场比赛。 与此同时,乌野高中与稻荷崎高中的比赛迎来第2局。但对于宫侑的发球攻势,西谷频频出现接球失误,使队伍处于劣势。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #20
programme.desc: 以影山的发球为契机,乌野高中逐渐不再让稻荷崎占有优势。 面对势如破竹的乌野,稻荷崎为了重整被扰乱的步调,派出主将北信介。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #21
programme.desc: 一行人与稻荷崎的比赛来到关键的第3局,双方展开激战。宫侑的发球以及角名的迅速攻击使乌野陷入苦战,于是让关键的发球员木下上场。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #22
programme.desc: 拼命托球的宫侑使稻荷崎再度变得势不可挡。虽然乌野处在劣势中,但接连有改变赛中趋势的表现。

programme.title: 重启人生的千金小姐正在攻略龙帝陛下 #9
programme.desc: 里斯提亚德掌握到哈迪斯的行踪,并将他带到艾琳西雅面前。吉儿虽一边劝哈迪斯与两人坐下来好好谈,一边却又采取了大胆行动。就在这个时候,帝国军竟开始放火袭击无辜的村庄。

programme.title: 重启人生的千金小姐正在攻略龙帝陛下 #10
programme.desc: 一行人为了与维塞尔皇太子的援军会合而开始行动,留在城里的艾琳西雅将两个弟弟托付给了吉儿。吉儿原本已重新下定决心要留在哈迪斯的身边,不再让他独自一人,没想到却事与愿违。

programme.title: 重启人生的千金小姐正在攻略龙帝陛下 #11
programme.desc: 艾琳西雅的背叛使哈迪斯遭到囚禁,吉儿则因被布伦希尔德传送至龙的巢穴而捡回一命。但栖息于该处的黑龙,却因为吉儿的魔力被封印住,而不承认她龙妃的身分。

programme.title: 重启人生的千金小姐正在攻略龙帝陛下 #12

programme.desc: 倒在路边且丧失记忆的爱猫男子九那岐被同样爱猫的阿学与小薰捡回去后,便开始在兄妹俩经营的猫咪咖啡厅「真心猫眼」工作。然而就在某天,猫咪咖啡厅的常客竟突然变成一只可爱猫咪。只要触碰猫就会变成猫的「喵瘟」在世界各地同时爆发,城市陷入一片混乱。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活尸猫之夜 #2
programme.desc: 阿学染上只要触碰猫就会变成猫的NN病毒,他嘱托九那岐留下他,带著妹妹小薰逃跑。陷入「喵瘟」的城市充满了可爱猫咪,九那岐、小薰及田西连为了和阿学分离而难过的时间都没有,只能不断找寻安全的地方。三人好不容易逃进超市,竟在那碰到小薰的同学筒美。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活尸猫之夜 #3
programme.desc: 「喵瘟」让日本政府正一路走向瓦解。与此同时,在超市等待救援的一行人,正在享用小薰特制的猫饭,度过了短暂的幸福时光。但不知道从哪闯进的猫破坏了一切,人们在眨眼间都变成了猫,店里一片混乱。为了逃离变为猫咪集会所的超市,他们想出的策略是什么?

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活尸猫之夜 #4
programme.desc: 一行人靠著筒美的超级猫咪侦测力「猫感力」避开猫群,在「喵瘟」蔓延的城市中移动。他们边奋命抵抗猫咪的迷人诱惑,边朝著较可能吸引救援直升机注目的高楼顶楼前进。多亏九那岐作为诱饵,独自与猫群玩耍,让其他人趁隙到达顶楼,但没想到直升机却已无空位。

programme.title: 主日讲坛-歌邻基督教会
programme.desc: 歌邻基督教会 讲题: 泪之旅途- 总不放手 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 「创世电视福音主日」-不由你不信之从万物创造到深邃的爱
programme.desc: 「超阔银幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大众化的福音主题」,加上「诚意的款待」会产生极致的「福音体验」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何从人类各器官的精密构造,看到上帝创造是多么奇妙伟大,每个人的出生就是一场最严谨的监制,原来正常的生命就是一场神迹。在领受上帝创造恩典之时,明白祂在创造过程对人的慈爱和关怀。

programme.title: 寇绍涵牧师-哥林多前书
programme.desc: 保罗教导当地的圣徒如何促进教会内的合一、如何学习神的事。透过寇绍涵牧师讲解,进深研读记载在哥林多前书中保罗的教导,即使周遭充斥著许多邪恶的事物,亦帮助我们明白要过正义生活的教义和原则。

programme.title: 福音电影专线:翻生奇兵
programme.desc: 文强自小被批为天煞孤星,误打误撞地来到方舟展馆工作,遇上至潮上帝,少女慈禧、伊甸娃娃、罗马兵丁、太空人、Indiana Jones等神迹翻生;恶魔袭击,文强如何靠著上帝和秘密武器应战呢?

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神秘
programme.desc: 从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容,都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释,除非这个世界在科学理论上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《圣经》实战攻略
programme.desc: 节目按不同主题,包括职场、家庭、恋爱、情绪、信仰生命,邀请七位牧者从《圣经》经文结合生活例子与大家一同灵修,建立一个不离地的信徒生命。

programme.title: 麦希真牧师-末了的话 专题的研究
programme.desc: 麦希真牧师:「我是八十三岁很老很老的基督工人,『还有末了的话』(林后13:11)要告诉你们。你们都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍为留心这些十分重要『末了的话』,也许有一点助益的。」麦希真牧师将《末了的话》分成八个部分共34个题目,此部为《 专题的研究》。

programme.title: 刘三论今-十项全能的家系列
programme.desc: 罗马书12:13 说:「圣徒缺乏,要帮补。」你觉得这也适用于你的家庭吗?为什么? 创世电视「信仰生活」系列 《刘三论今》,以圣经观点来讲述婚姻家庭的重要性,加进动画、话剧、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地气的轻松方式来教导我们婚姻家庭的经营。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探电影：瓢虫遗迹之谜粤日
programme.desc: 点点村出现了罕灾，一点雨水都没有。屁屁丹迪前往调查，结识了一位少女熊猫妲。为了找到熊猫妲的爷爷，两人一同前往遗迹；中途虽遇上贼人，但在屁屁侦探的帮助下，两人终成功令点点村下起雨来。

programme.title: 高朋满座#88粤
programme.desc: 溢发现送件速度日减，结果查出因重了影响表现，义取笑溢需要买专为肥人而设的「肥仔裤」，而溢去购买时竟遇上亨，二人决定参加男士美容中心的修身疗程。当到美容中心，溢却闹出不少笑话，竟利用蒸气热石来烘三文治。

programme.title: 尚食#28粤普
programme.desc: 子衿发现被瞻基、紫萍所骗，失望又气愤，随后又因被禁足勾起往日阴影，竟突然失声，瞻基却误会她是赌气不愿开口认错。太后以仁孝皇后为例，请求子衿以社稷福祉为先，个人恩怨为后，子衿动容不已，奈何无法言语。

programme.title: 香港本色粤 及 鼎植口腔呈献：齿中守护你粤
programme.desc: 被列入本港首份非物质文化遗产清单的传统手艺有不少逐渐式微，但「搭棚的艺术」仍然长青。在天后诞，不少地方会搭出大大小小的戏棚，而堪称「史上难度最高」的戏棚，位于蒲台岛的悬崖。蒲台岛那么大，戏棚为何非建在悬崖边不可？要装饰戏棚，传统的花牌是必然之选。在出身花牌世家的蔡荣基眼中，花牌并非单纯是一门生意，而是讲究组件、字句、图案配合的艺术。现今事事讲求效率，何以他仍乐意花上两天时间准备一组字？

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 八角、桂皮、花椒等，皆是鼎爷常用的中式香料，他是根据甚么条件去选用？寻找仍然承传的竹筛肠粉踪迹，菜脯肠粉似是潮州食法，如何将滋味加倍？鼎爷今集专注做两道「功夫菜」，先有「酒香火焰鸭」，直接于煲内放置材料，分两次盖好焖煮，连蚝油亦要分两次下。最后加米酒做出火焰效果，兼可提升鸭肉香味！另一款美食「鱼汤鲜虾银针粉」，采用杂鱼熬出洁白汤底，还要预备蛋丝巧制。除了用作入味的鱼汤，猪油渣亦是「鼎级」点缀。

programme.title: 汇丰保险呈献 :准备退休有乜计粤
programme.desc: 退休是一段崭新的人生篇章，值得细心规划与期待。若可提前安排好财务、健康、生活的方向，便能于退休后真正享受自在和安稳。王祖蓝、李亚男这对演艺圈的模范夫妇，引领观众从不同方面切入，认知退休所需准备，务求可在财务与生活规划上更周全，得以轻松迎接属于自己的人生新阶段。

programme.title: 汇丰Premier Elite 呈献：《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》粤
programme.desc: 金融市场瞬息万变，加上科技发展日新月异，如何影响投资市场？《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》，云集不同行业专家，剖析市场趋势，讲解金融、投资及理财等话题，务求做到深入浅出，聚焦分析不同议题，为大家捕捉市场先机。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 鼻咽癌的早期病征包括耳痛、鼻涕倒流、单侧鼻塞、鼻涕带血丝等，临床肿瘤科医生提醒要留意这些「警号」，并细说诊断方法。早期鼻咽癌以放射治疗为主，晚期会将免疫治疗与化疗二者结合，再以电疗加固，如何发挥出协同效应？手腕内有一条腕管，如因过度劳损而变窄，会压住重要的「正中神经」。物理治疗师概述腕管综合症与「妈妈手」的分别，并传授三组简单动作，有助缓解相关不适。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，Annie奉上「葱烧鸡扒」。

programme.title: 医度讲粤

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 维修钟表讲眼力又考记性，钟表店老板在上海街扎根半世纪，技术精湛，绝非「做一日和尚敲一日钟－ 得过且过」！老板还介绍店内拥有逾百年历史的表撞、表座。香港制衣业曾兴旺一时，出售衣车的商店开得其门如市；「衣车叔叔」细谈行业兴衰史。重阳节的登高习俗呈现中国传统孝道，「佛山孝子」登高竟被视为虚情假意？「沙头角村长个女」，到底是男是女？另外，中文讲师廖舜禧试从中式建筑学问解构人际关系，要做个有承担的「架梁」！

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粤

programme.title: 奇迹小店粤
programme.desc: 一个传承自黄飞鸿的跌打医馆品牌，第二代传人李灿窝因为一个承诺，从师母手中接掌医馆，并秉承要悬壶济世的教诲，以相宜诊金为街坊服务。他还示范推拿技巧，原来推动方向的顺逆，效用大有分别！此外，黄飞鸿的「无影脚」名震中外，李灿窝却指其实没有这门功夫，何出此言？走进深水埗一间跌打医馆，映入眼帘的是一片粉红色，原来这是出于跌打医师梁天柱对女儿「爱的表现」？肥妈即席请梁医师替她治理脚患，却担心会出现尴尬情况？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 「美丑」定义各有不同，有人注重外表，为了展现最美一面，会将照片修饰到满意后才于社交媒体发放；有人则认为相由心生，内涵更重要。节目组请来四位艺人作自我介绍，并进行二选一问答与才艺表演，小朋友对各人的审美观感可有变化？刘展霆、李尔晨均选择以事业为先，为何被扣印象分？黄洛妍的小提琴造诣，打动小朋友心坎；获赞颜值高的陈星妤，表演魔术却似有失分……经过这次体验，孩子们都认同才华内涵可令人发光发亮，变得更美！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤PG
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日

新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 本港创科发展过往被指以学术为本，技术与需求脱节，科研成果难以落地。但经过多年发展，本港八间资助大学上学年知识转移收入高达142亿元，按年大增超过两成。科研人员是怎样将实验室研究成果转化落地，变成在市场上销售的产品呢？本港研发总开支在过去10年间增长超过一倍，但当中近6成都是由政府出钱，工商界投资只有不足4成，远低于于邻近的日本、南韩和内地等，如何才能建构本港的创科生态圈呢？

programme.desc: 周佩婷接棒游上海，先带大家减减压。体验过弹床、水床等轻量级设施后，她走进「破坏屋」发泄对导演的不满！有古董发烧友自设博物馆，收藏了逾千件珍品，佩婷换上旗袍细味旧物故事。现代商场内隐藏老上海大街，完美还原昔日情怀，并提供各式街头美食。到访网红餐厅品尝精致佳肴之后，佩婷一试「高温泥土浴」，不需运动亦可消耗卡路里？虹口区有餐厅主打咸蛋黄美食，好邪恶！佩婷还闯进神秘后花园，与貂鼠、羊驼等动物近距离接触。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 蒜子是不可或缺的配料，还具多种功效。肥妈将蒜子「升呢」主角，呈献多道美食，还向农场负责人请教种蒜方法。阿妈用健康食材烹调「黑蒜莲藕素汤」，虽因说错姬松茸的名称被6号「疯狂抽水」，仍不忘提醒大家黑蒜连皮更有益！「蒜子鸡髀菇焖鸡髀」中的鸡髀菇爽口腍身，也是精华所在。肥妈及后炒香蒜子，连同鳝片放于砂锅内焗煮，「啫啫」声不绝！阿6则以简易步骤做出「黄金蒜片芝士薄饼」，两种「重口味」食物搭配起来，格外惹味。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈在岸边指挥6号登上小艇，随渔民到塘中捞虾，收获甚丰。主持们把捕捞的南美白虾带回厨房，炮制「薯仔沙律」，还加入含有丰富膳食纤维的藜麦，增添口感。期间，阿6更自揭在法国吃海鲜的糗事。在家亦可炒出鲜香十足的「海胆炒饭」！阿妈教路要炒出粒粒分明的黄金炒饭，秘诀在事前准备功夫。她又利用真空密实袋慢煮牛仔架，令肉质保持粉红嫩滑。阿妈还指导6号用电饭煲煮「紫薯糖水」，但她因何事突然大叫「唔好」及「救命」？

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟凑吖!粤PG
programme.desc: 「爸知弊幼稚园」以残酷入学题考验林盛斌、太太黄乙颐与幼子林道申(Jaye)，被问到爸妈二选一，Jaye口里说「拣唔到」，身体却很诚实……一家人透过绘画让专家分析心理，「校长」黎诺懿笑言解读出Bob仍有生育想法？凑仔挑战正式开始，Bob要单独教儿子背出「3」乘数表，但零进展下只好试行洗脑教学！看图搓泥胶游戏，Jaye完成手作后一脸自信，Bob为错误复制作品向儿子道歉，Jaye道出甚么令众人爆笑？

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟凑吖!粤PG
programme.desc: 结识新朋友时间，外向的Bob偕幼子Jaye，与内敛的素人爸爸和女儿芊妤聚餐。Jaye细心发现芊妤衣服藏着一条薯条，打破寂静局面！他还提到讨厌Bob枕头有臭味而被追问，即显露出爸爸做主持的才能顺利转移话题。突然难度升级，Bob接获太太乙颐指示再教儿子背熟「4」乘数表……陪子女温功课好费神，两组家庭温习后比拼抢答测验；Jaye太看重成败，专家带来小贴士！妈妈们惊喜回归，Bob父子能否展现背乘数表成果？

programme.title: 非洲潮什么粤
programme.desc: 梁芷珮和家人经新加坡转机，首站未达非洲范围，先抵「渡假天堂」马尔代夫！芷珮预订的渡假屋，位于水上，出门走几步楼梯即可投进浅海浮潜。重点是租金包三餐，酒水亦随意饮个够本，随教练前往团体浮潜都是免费。近海自然食海鲜，沙滩上享用海鲜晚餐，无调味亦够美味！鱼从何来？芷珮带子女出海，体验马尔代夫渔民的传统开住船钓鱼法，最终有多少渔获？浅水浮潜哪会足够？芷珮还包船、包岛玩浮潜、食海鲜，并于水中跟鲨鱼见一面！

programme.title: 非洲潮什么粤
programme.desc: 塞舌尔岛是非洲收入较高的岛国，曾被法国统治。芷珮一行人经杜拜转机来到，先往当地的市场，看看有什么手工艺品可当手信，收获不少！与首站马尔代夫相若，芷珮预订的渡假村套房都是食、住、玩全包，带小朋友到访亦不成问题，因有儿童营地。免费出海玩帆船与亲子桨板，随意跳进水中爽一番！当地亦有不少本地团，众人随团坐观光船，欣赏海底鱼类畅泳，再登上只有一人居住的小岛，探访庞大的陆龟，还伸手抚摸，摸龟壳原来会触动神经？

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 每年一度的父亲节，孝顺子女都会落足心思，发挥创意为爸爸炮制惊喜。香港小姐邵珮诗向阿古(古嘉俊)请教特色甜品，让她在父亲节表孝心。阿古为了今次示范的「泰式香茅焦糖茶杯」落足心思，当中以朱古力制成的茶杯型外层，造型相当别致。味道方面，他想出以泰式香茅融入西式风格，破格配搭凸显阿古的非凡创作力。原来邵珮诗每年都有指定的父亲节庆祝活动，不但过程有益健康，龙虾与甜品更是当中必备元素，她跟大家分享温馨回忆。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 文化祭将至，2年A班决定办咖啡室，以阿茜的侍应打扮和良太的大宫拿坡里意粉作卖点，矢志夺得SOP奖。其间敌人来袭，E6和E7因维修无法出战，幸好有阿天和紫苑补上，太晴用支援钻地车击败敌人。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 结他弹唱的难度甚高，因为稍有唱错、弹错都很容易被发现。这集「My Little Show」就有一位勇敢少年前来挑战，并透过两首英文歌传递欢乐。四位型格小舞者送上充满活力的精彩表演，还提到为了让舞蹈整齐同步而紧密排练，更希望令观众留下深刻印象。音乐与美食都可带来幸福感，结他导师将两者合一，联同主持们合唱两首「美食之歌」，并畅谈饮食喜好与习惯。导师还提起一个「空气结他大赛」，背后理念是甚么？

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 改编自人气绘本。各位小朋友快跟著无人不知的名侦探屁屁侦探全面出击，透过细心观察及推理，侦破各类案件吧！

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 职业棒球赛季开锣，学校的男生都热衷于棒球的话题，但小丸子与小玉无法理解棒球的有趣之处。另一方面，小丸子爸爸也是棒球迷，为了看电视直播晚间比赛，导致其他家人看不到想看的节目。对此，一家人开始积累不满。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 近期有多个内地网吧品牌，先后来港开业，是甚么因素吸引他们加入市场。美以伊战争开打，对香港的电子产品贸易，产生甚么影响？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
星期日档案粤
programme.desc: 城市不断发展，原本生活在野外的动物，生存空间越来越少。例如在西贡，马路越拓越阔，过路的黄牛成为车下亡魂；在金山郊野，喂饲行为改变猕猴的生存本能；一些爬虫类动物成为人类异宠，但最终被弃养，城市的发展和人类的行为，如何无意中改变动物的命运？究竟谁才是打破大自然规律和和平冲的不速之客？今集会走访西贡、金山，了解一班义工及收容团体如何和野生动物「和谐共处」。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港何济公止痛退热散呈献：中年好声音4粤
programme.desc: 「快慢二重奏」下半场，即将引领观众投入节拍强劲的快歌世界。选手们维持既有的分队组合，出场次序则会按上回的排名决定。五位参赛者纵已获得晋级襟章，但仍全力以赴，为拍档争取出线资格。当这集的快歌比拼结束后，最终未能获得襟章的十位选手中，将有两人要离开。此外，评审们也会选出荣膺「快慢二重奏」的MVP队伍。

programme.title: 一周星星粤
programme.desc: 吴彦祖受电影导演梁乐民邀请，回归参与港产片拍摄，拍过荷里活制作的他，返港演戏坦言「舒服」？彦祖透露拍这部戏前有咨询家人意见，而当年是因「玩够」故决定结婚？婚姻没让其生活改变，直至女儿出世，他才有大转变？谢君豪、吴慷仁在片中合演首富父子，提到参考了多个富豪家族。「两父子」一场掌掴戏令人深刻，君豪更即席「掌掴」主持王镇泉让他感受一下！慷仁做演员前曾打过数十份工，他又猜到君豪入读演艺学院前的工作吗？

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
叠影狙击#20粤PG
programme.desc: 飞飞虽然保住性命，但是手脚瘫痪，勗杰和晓晨想尽办法鼓励他重新振作；文诺说服泽淮出面支持私有化，此举反而令私有化计划无法通过，正中文诺下怀；文诺得知俊雄的下落后，带著晓晨去找他，怎料俊雄竟然叫她金夫人…

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 余思霆收拾好行李，请一日假便飞台北，获地胆拍档金刚接机，即搭机场捷运向市中心出发！旅程第一餐品尝足料鸡腿汤，未吃完已心思思要到宁夏夜市，寻觅同获「车胎人」推介的芋饼、猪肝汤与蚵仔煎。日间于隐世咖啡店享用三层塔茶点，夜晚深入窄巷酒吧，启动门口机关，走进以蜂巢为主题的设计格局并浅酌一番。翌晨，两人排长龙买早餐，再登上公园边赏花边医肚，偏黑色的卤肉饭有多滋味？下午行程有两款选择，叹啡、浸温泉，悉随尊便。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 旅途第二晚，吃到尽！先有抵食海鲜加肉材一人一锅，其他配料、蔬菜任添，再来意想不到的盐酥鸡当宵夜；连放松做Spa都有点心吃？第三日早上，两大行程可拣，好动的可以滑水，金刚体验「沙发滑水」，感受如何？爱静的可跟思霆往赤峰街商圈做个文青，购物、打卡、来个小清新套餐。终极血拼阶段，到永康街一带寻找合适手信，台湾特色小食、茶叶、精致生活小物，任君选择。上机前再享用炭火烹制的姜母鸭，记住金刚建议最后才吃鸭肉！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈在岸边指挥6号登上小艇，随渔民到塘中捞虾，收获甚丰。主持们把捕捞的南美白虾带回厨房，炮制「薯仔沙律」，还加入含有丰富膳食纤维的藜麦，增添口感。期间，阿6更自揭在法国吃海鲜的糗事。在家亦可炒出鲜香十足的「海胆炒饭」！阿妈教路要炒出粒粒分明的黄金炒饭，秘诀在事前准备功夫。她又利用真空密实袋慢煮牛仔架，令肉质保持粉红嫩滑。阿妈还指导6号用电饭煲煮「紫薯糖水」，但她因何事突然大叫「唔好」及「救命」？

programme.title: 小小动物历险记(完)
programme.desc: 动物园可真是个疯狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陆的动物，如今都在一起共同生活。但对一群好朋友来说，动物园就是他们的家！这里有活泼好动的大象拉拉、聪明的鳄鱼沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獭可可子，还有勇敢的鸽子狄尔，快来和我们一起认识这群朋友吧！

programme.title: 小小动物历险记特别篇
programme.desc: 圣诞节将至，动物园里来了一位新成员–阿光，他是一只活力充沛的穿山甲。来看看小小野生动物园要怎么因应随之而来的混乱，以及学习如何与这位新伙伴相处吧！特别篇中有三首由艺人ShiGGaShay、EstelleFly和YAØ演唱的全新歌曲，精彩不容错过！

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家(完)
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.desc: 最接地气的外景行脚节目,由名人带领网路红人到店家体验吃、喝、玩、乐。寓教于乐，带给观众耳目一新的超强体验。

programme.title: 当你沉睡时
programme.desc: 拥有预知梦能力的洪珠，因总是只能梦见未来却无力改变而让她痛苦。不是金汤匙出生也没有优秀的学历及人脉，却总是富有充满正义感的检察官宰璨。两人的相遇为了阻止梦境的可怕事件变成现实，开始相信对方是否能成为扭转未来的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花总相逢
programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 人气封锁中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同时作为转学生的机率，是旼财意想不到的巧合。与作为人气女王敏在协议交换身份生活，原本逐渐透明的生活开始画上色彩。随著时间害怕被拆穿，同时只在敏在面前直率的申义俊，在他的陪伴与守护找到自我。

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地气的外景行脚节目,由名人带领网路红人到店家体验吃、喝、玩、乐。寓教于乐，带给观众耳目一新的超强体验。

programme.title: 家宴(完)
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 逆转女王
programme.desc: 【经典韩剧《贤内助女王》姊妹作】黄泰熙原是高薪的开发组长，但为了追求幸福家庭，她选择与新同事奉俊秀结婚。然而她的决定，却让她被信任的女上司赶出公司，只能在家当贤内助。五年后，泰熙感到现实生活的沉重，决定重返职场。在公司她遇见了具勇植，一位支持她的本部长。泰熙在勇植的鼓励下展现出更坚韧的一面，最终成功东山再起，找到了新的事业目标。

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 当你沉睡时
programme.desc: 拥有预知梦能力的洪珠，因总是只能梦见未来却无力改变而让她痛苦。不是金汤匙出生也没有优秀的学历及人脉，却总是富有充满正义感的检察官宰璨。两人的相遇为了阻止梦境的可怕事件变成现实，开始相信对方是否能成为扭转未来的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花总相逢
programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 人气封锁中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同时作为转学生的机率，是旼财意想不到的巧合。与作为人气女王敏在协议交换身份生活，原本逐渐透明的生活开始画上色彩。随著时间害怕被拆穿，同时只在敏在面前直率的申义俊，在他的陪伴与守护找到自我。

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: Baby Riki

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.title: Counting With Paula
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Take Off
programme.desc: Po collects lots of balloons and takes off into the air! Floating high above Teletubbyland, Po waves at Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa‐Laa below. When the balloons pop, Po lands.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S4) - Shorts
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'shorts' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see all sorts of shorts - red shorts, stripy shorts, kick it really far shorts and flamingo shorts!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Space Cucumber
programme.desc: Can there ever be such a thing as too much Messy? OKIDO is about to find out.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Dot Pursuit
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to make sure Dot doesn't see her present before her birthday party. But that's easier said than done when Dot becomes an unstoppable present-hunting machine.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Loveable Duggee and the Squirrels return with more educational fun.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Go Jet Academy: New Species
programme.desc: The team goes on a jungle expedition to find a mysterious creature. But while they race to discover a brand new species, something seems to be watching them from the treetops.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Magic Xylophone
programme.desc: As Bluey and Bingo squabble over their magic xylophone, Dad seizes control and freezes Bluey, leaving Bingo as her only hope.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Featherwand
programme.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Kangaroos
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen and Scout head to Australia on a baby animal mission to solve the mystery of why a group of kangaroos, and their joeys, are living on a beach. Along the way, Andy is chased by a pack of dingoes and hops to safety with the baby kangaroos.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Peas
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have fun looking for peas with the Playtimers in their Pea Party game.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Space Badge
programme.desc: Duggee teaches the squirrels all about the stars, the planets and the Milky Way!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Spooky Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound. What is going on?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Obstacle Course Badge
programme.desc: It's time for the annual Animal Obstacle Course Race. The animals need to work together in teams to complete the course.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Great Mosque of Djenne, Africa
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is invited to Djenne in Mali, Africa, to visit the people and to see one of his favourite things at work - mud.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Kinderdijk, Netherlands
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to Kinderdijk in The Netherlands to celebrate National Mill Day.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Steam Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Thomas and the steam trains spring into action when Porter and the diesel engines run into a series of accidents that throw their deliveries off track.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Snow
programme.desc: It has snowed and almost no one can get about. Stanley builds a snow plough out of surf boards to clear the streets and makes a huge snow hill so that his friends can sledge down it.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Art Park
programme.desc: Fifi and Fred help Stanley clear the park after a storm so it's ready for an Art Competition. The children use the recycled rubbish they found to make their pieces.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - My Dad Calls My Mum a Badger
programme.desc: Kisses, cuddles, and making renewable energy from cow poo! Parents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to make up a story
programme.desc: When JoJo can't find her favourite Captain Chloe storybook, Gran Gran suggests they make up their own story.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Chilli sets up an obstacle course in the backyard, but Bluey is disheartened when Bandit turns it into a race and beats her. After cheating in a rematch, Bluey discovers the importance of training in order to improve her skills.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Day Off Badge
programme.desc: It's Duggee's day off but the Squirrels show up to tell him about their adventures.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Duck Badge
programme.desc: The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Norway
programme.desc: Ubercorn and Glitch head to the Svalbard Global Seed Vault. But, just like when they were cadets together, the two of them get into trouble.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Apple
programme.desc: Apple sings in celebration of her great-great-grandad, Apple Tree's, 100th birthday.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Broccoli
programme.desc: It's Broccoli and his floret, Broc, performing their phenomenal ventriloquist act.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - The Tato Team
programme.desc: During the Veggies' Super Sidekick Costume Contest, Evil Pea traps Supertato in a jar of honey. All is lost until the Veggies become real super sidekicks, the Tato Team!

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Take Off
programme.desc: Po collects lots of balloons and takes off into the air! Floating high above Teletubbyland, Po waves at Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa‐Laa below. When the balloons pop, Po lands.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming's overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters & recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal. Yuan is furious, but when the local triads enter the picture, Yuan and Ling join hands to take back the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Driven by prophecy, Lord Conqueror murders Wind and Cloud's parents, then raises the boys as his own. Years later, their power rivals his, so he secretly plots their deaths. However, when his daughter falls for both young men, jealousy ignites. The moment he betroths her to Wind, a fatal battle becomes inevitable.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building - only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature segment "Global Debate".

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Mister Mastodon
programme.desc: Po and team arrive in Guatemala and meet farmers who are facing a mysterious threat-- named The Protector, wielding the Storm Wheels. Elsewhere, Colin the Stag Knight and Weimin team up to go after Po and discover Mr. Ping's connection to the widely feared Pirate Queen.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - D'aja Vu
programme.desc: Stuck in a time-loop, Aja finds unlikely help from Jim Lake and Team Trollhunters. Meanwhile, a giant Troll rampages the Arcadia High Science Fair, threatening to expose both the Troll world and Aja and Krel’s alien secret.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Flying the Coop
programme.desc: A menacing school board Administrator demands Aja and Krel's immigration papers to register for school - a task that turns dangerous for the two "illegal Aliens." Meanwhile, Aja bejins her warrior training with Vex

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Party Crashers
programme.desc: Aja attends her first teem party, Krel goes hunting for an urban legend with Eli, but the kids' fun is ruined when the Zeron Brotherhood crash their night. Meanwhile, Vex receives a message from Akiridion-5.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Packet Racket Smack Me Down
programme.desc: When a shady group of bugs moves into the city selling artificial ketchup, Turbo and Shadow go undercover to expose who is behind the operation. After Turbo is challenged to compete in an underground smack-talk contest, he must get lessons from the best insult snail there is, Burn.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Smoovin On Up The Great Shell Robbery
programme.desc: Smoove Move goes from underground street artist to world-famous pedicurist and lets his newfound fame go to his head. Thieving hermit crabs steal the crew's shells, so they concoct an elaborate heist to get them back.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Four Flamingos The Roaring Rooster
programme.desc: Archibald eats too many beets and teams up with lumberjacks for a logging competition. Sage tries to earn all his Roaring Rooster badges in one day.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Players
programme.desc: It's time for the Toyland football match but the game can't go ahead until Noddy finds the missing players. Noddy discovers that someone misdirected Pat Pat and Deltoid so that they'd miss the match. Noddy finds the missing players and reunites everyone at the real football pitch but then Hoof disappears. Noddy discovers that Hoof misdirected the others because he wanted to be the best player.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Changed Basketball Hoop
programme.desc: Noddy's about to play a game of basketball with Big Ears and Deltoid when he realizes that the hoop has been fiddled with. Who could've done that and why? Noddy's investigation leads him to Fuse, who explains that he just wanted to help the toys that weren't as skilled as him. Everyone practises and realises that the best way to improve at sport is to keep practising. Well done Noddy.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Ruined Crops
programme.desc: Farmer Tom is confused and upset when he finds all his trees and corn knocked over. Noddy decides to investigate: who spoiled Farmer Tom's crops? He soon discovers lots of strange heavy bags scattered all over the farm. Whose are they? Where did they come from? And what could they possibly have to do with Smartysaurus's new hot air balloon?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Broken Pulley
programme.desc: The Head Builder isn't happy. Someone's been playing with the builders' stuff and now their pulley doesn't work. Noddy decides he needs to find out who did it before anything else goes wrong. Who broke the Builders' pulley?

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Crocodile Has A Bumpy Back
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Crocodile didn't have a bumpy back. His skin was all smooth and he had to be very careful of the hot Tinga Tinga sun. One day whilst napping Crocodile gets very sunburnt and falls into a deep sleep. Lion warns all the animals to be on their guard as the Wildebeest have returned to Tinga Tinga and they could stampede at any moment. Crocodile misses the meeting, snoring under the hot sun.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Jackal Howls At The Moon
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Jackal didn't howl at the moon. He was a trickster and he always wanted what was not rightfully his. Jackal took over Hen's nest and Aardvark's burrow. He even took the cub's supper from Mama Cheetah! Enough was enough! All the animals decide to teach Jackal a lesson and make him believe that the Moon is made of the sweetest, most delicious honey in Tinga Tinga. Of course, Jackal instantly wants some… but it never comes.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat's Pop Star Rescue
programme.desc: Everyone in Greendale is excited because pop superstar, Brad Lee is coming to Pencaster Bay to perform a concert. Unfortunately Brad's luxury private ship has broken down en route so Pat and Jess must head out to sea in the SDS boat and collect him. Meanwhile Julian, Meera, Bill and Sarah are on the train to Pencaster Bay with their mums to watch the concert. The kids enter into a cacophonous ‘sing off' to decide who is the best singer.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Very Important Person
programme.desc: PC Selby is being honoured with a medal for being "Best local Policeman of the year" and Pat is despatched to Pencaster bay to collect both the medal and the person who is going to present it; The Duchess of Pencaster! Somewhat star struck Pat and Jess drive the Duchess towards Pencaster back to the award ceremony at Greendale but at her request they stop to help some of the villagers which unfortunately leads to her getting covered in coal dust and mud!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Mr Carburettor's Birthday Suit
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is off to try out his new wetsuit at the beach… it may come in useful when rain is forecast for the big race the next day!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Big Bangs
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is planning a big firework display up at the farm. Can Roary help Tin Top overcome his fear of bangs in time for the display?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Pizza
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has demanded pizza for lunch but the pizzeria is closed. How is Marsha going to ensure Mr Carburettor gets the lunch he asked for?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Stars
programme.desc: Roary is feeling put out as all the cars are paying Conrod too much attention. He is determined to show his worth when they race that afternoon. But tries too hard and ends up in danger. Who can save him?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - Case Of The Broken Crystal Memory Game
programme.desc: All the toys are ready to start the exciting DareDale Challenge race, which culminates in the competitors successfully completing the Crystal Memory Game in the DareDale Caves. Before the race can start everyone is disappointed to discover that the Crystal Memory Game has been broken. Whilst Clockwork Mouse gets the game mended, Noddy must investigate who broke the game so that they don't break it again.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Amazing Eyebrows
programme.desc: It's the day of the Best Toy Award in Toyland and Fuse is the winner! He's very excited but when his new dressing up eyebrows that he wanted to wear to the ceremony go missing, he's devastated. It's up the Noddy to investigate who has taken the amazing eyebrows so that he can get them back to Fuse before the ceremony starts.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Hiding Pirates
programme.desc: Everyone is excited about singing sea shanties in the big Pirate Party in Toyland. But when Scurvy the Parrot arrives at Toy Green all on his own Noddy soon realises that the pirates are missing.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Music Player
programme.desc: Noddy's new music player starts a craze for the latest dance, the Toy Twist. He decides to have a big dance party that night! All his friends are excited apart from Smartysaurus, who can't dance. When the music player goes missing, Noddy must use all his investigative skills of listening, looking and following clues on the WhoWhatWhere Tablet to find out who has taken the music player and why.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Easter Kitty Bunny
programme.desc: It’s Easter-time in the dollhouse! When Gabby unboxes an Easter basket with an orange egg inside, all the Gabby Cats want to know what’s inside, but when CatRat accidentally sends it rolling out of Kitty Fairy’s garden, Gabby and Pandy go on a springtime search through the Dollhouse to find it. Then, when the egg hatches, they meet Eggy, the Easter Kitty Bunny! For our Cat of the Day segment, Baby Box gets crafty.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Detectives
programme.desc: There's a mystery in the dollhouse! When things start to mysteriously disappear around the dollhouse, Gabby and Pandy play detectives, using all their senses to find clues, follow them, and solve the mystery. For our COTD segment, CatRat and Baby Me-Owls show us how to make ice cube paints!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they’re invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Amazing Donna Bye, Bye Boardie
programme.desc: When Donna decides to show off her not-so-flashy skills as a magician at the Community Center talent show, the Zenkos must do everything they can to save her act from becoming an embarrassing disaster. After Sam’s favorite skateboard accidentally gets put in with donations Mr. Tanaka is collecting for a fundraiser, the team is led on a merry chase as the skateboard passes from one Harmony Harbor denizen to another.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Cleat without Feet Real Magic
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harper's soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his "magic hat," they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylan’s magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Angry Abnormal Atrocities of the Astute Animal Agressors
programme.desc: Stuck in separate camps, Harold and George unleash a hyperintelligent talking possum to scare the pants off of Krupp. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Problematic Pandemonium of the Punishing Plungerina
programme.desc: After helping George and Harold make a comic featuring the heroine Plungerina, Erica asserts that Plungerina could be better that Captain Underpants. To prove her wrong, the boys decide to actually create the villain in the comic and then have Captain Underpants save the day. Unfortunately, Krupp - and therefore Captain Underpants - is away at a principals' convention.There's no one to save them...until a real life Plungerina saves tthe day! But who is really Plungerina?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Blitzkrieg of the Bothersome Butt-erflies
programme.desc: As a prank, George and Harold use Melvin's new animal hybrid invention to create a creature that's a cross between a butt and a fly. But some of the monster butt-erflies want to eat everything in sight- including the students hiding out in the school gym!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Dastardlys Deed of the Devious Diddlysaurus
programme.desc: George and Harold decide to do an extra credit project on dinosaurs to help their chances of getting summer camp-worthy grades. When Melvin brings in a dinosaur frozen in ice, the boys try to get rid of it. But the ice thaws and they meet Diddlysaurus, a prankster raptor who's huge fans of the boys. He offers to help them with their project if he can pull pranks with them, but when the pranks go too far, the boys and Captain Underpants have to deal with the dino.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when there's no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the "Whoopsies!" Song.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Rollodons
programme.desc: When tar fills the cracks of the crater, the Dinotrux must find a way to herd the free-roaming Rollodons to help smooth over the sticky situation.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Two-Wheeled Terror
programme.desc: When Lucky and the PALs arrive home from the circus, they find that Maricela and her new bicycle have become the star attraction in Miradero

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Shadowy Syndrome of the Sinister Splotch
programme.desc: Captain Underpants becomes a wanted man in underwear when footage surfaces of a robber who looks exactly like him. George and Harold, positive it's an impostor, try to track down the perp and bring him to justice. But can the boys do this before Captain Underpants is found guilty?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - An Uphill Battle
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Big Break
programme.desc: Boss thought that breaking his arm was painful;but the true pain starts at pediatrician Dr. Kevin’s "jokes." Boss enlists the playgroup babies to defang the doctor of his "comedian’s disease." Tim obsesses about keeping his little brother safe.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Escape From Krinkle's
programme.desc: Boss has an opportunity to get his old job back at Baby Corp;but to get the interview;he’ll need the playgroup babies to help him escape Marsha Krinkle’s super-safe Bubbeezee playroom. Tim nearly misses Kabob Day at school.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Puppy Party!
programme.desc: Boss comes face to face with his old nemesis;Bug The Pug;after the playgroup parents decide to throw a Puppy Party. Staci creates a "No-Paperworkist" movement to avoid Buddy From HR’s constant paperwork.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Enter SH1FT3R
programme.desc: Tony goes head-to-head with SH1FT3R’s main recruiter Layla Gray in a death-defying spy race through LA Tunnels, parking lots and construction sites.
